methodology.decisions: hash32(economy-t8a, inputSeed, storyletId, age) modulo choice count; no simulation RNG consumption. All mandatory choices resolved.
methodology.window: Once per year at phase 3 after mandatory decisions and all beats, before tick. Purchases from 16; choice-quality denominator is living ages >=18. Checkpoints immediately after tick, only if still alive, before pending choice/purchases.
methodology.moments: Main: let moments expire through beat/tick without skip effects. Sensitivity: take every available moment immediately, up to three attention per year, before shopping.
methodology.focus: Saver/Moderate/Explorer/Spender: study; Careerist: work; Family: relationships. setFocus every year when allowed; engine fallback when unavailable.

policies.Moderate: Priority: courses until two current-profession courses; cabin from26; dome from30; family on ages divisible by10; sector on ages divisible by8. At most one purchase per year, retain two forecast annual bills and reject projected tight year.
policies.Careerist: Course whenever eligible, no reserve, no reduced load; work focus. Not a course-only comparison.
policies.Family: Priority: family whenever eligible; cabin from26; dome from30; first course. Retain one forecast annual bill, reject projected tight year. Reduce from40 if canSetLoad and balance >=max(domain reserve,3 projected annual bills); return full if balance falls below one projected annual bill and canSetLoad.
policies.Explorer: One sector per year in lexicographic sector-ID order; dome; cabin from26. Retain one forecast annual bill, reject projected tight year. No course or family purchases.
policies.Spender: Priority: course,cabin,dome,family,sector x4. Finite eight checks, real resource limits only, no reserve or load changes.

methodology.targets: Sectors sorted by ID, exclude current/visited, domain maximum4. Family: eligible real known living people sorted by descending bond then ID; first up to3; domain minimum2 and cooldown5.
methodology.choiceQuality: One representative deterministic target per offer/category. Nonfinancial eligibility inferred only from canBuy success or its final money/attention refusal. Every pair of individually available different categories is tried in both real purchase orders. All-category feasibility uses exhaustive real purchase sequences, once per category, not every possible repeat/sector. Empty catalogue is reported separately; it is not can-buy-all or nothing-affordable. Annual obligations are not charged up front in this metric; future commitments are reported in spending and forecasts.
methodology.spending: Full lifetime actions and annual observations are captured as they occur, not reconstructed from capped ledger/years. H1 restoration excluded from purchase counts. Entry fees and real annual rent/service bills reported separately. Zero-price dome activation counts as use, not as a positive-cost purchase.
methodology.survivorBias: No dead-life imputation. Exact-age living checkpoints; terminal-year settlement contributes lifetime accounting but not surviving checkpoint counts. Annual tariffs only for working checkpoints; pension shown separately.
methodology.attribution: Paired main strategies are descriptive policy comparisons; focus and ensuing narratives differ. CourseOnlyStudy/Saver and Careerist/noCourses isolate the course policy within this model; Family/fullLoad isolates load policy including downstream changes. Checkpoint deltas use joint survivors. Immediate-effect share measures direct stats/skills/person bonds or a used dome year, not human value.
methodology.reproducibility: No timestamps, random IDs, RNG calls or modified character inputs in pilot. Primary runs and sensitivity use exactly the same input seeds. Base revision identifies domain rules, not a self-referential output commit.
limitations: T5 not complete; paid retraining not assessed.
T6/T7 purchase stories and reactions absent.
Bots are not players; technical conflict is not emotional attractiveness.
No voluntary service cancellation in these fixed policies.
Population/lifetime means include infant deaths; conditional counts and joint-survivor results are explicit.
